description: This file implements the DatatableReadService interface for data access and manipulation within the data query infrastructure of the Fineract platform. It contains methods for retrieving datatable names, specific datatable details, executing data queries (including advanced queries with pagination and sorting), building embedded SQL queries, and counting entries. It interacts with JDBC for database operations, uses utility classes for validation, header mapping, and query construction, and enforces security permissions.

classes.name: DatatableReadServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the DatatableReadService interface for data retrieval and query execution related to data tables within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: retrieveDatatableNames
methods.description: Retrieves a list of datatable metadata accessible to the current user, optionally filtered by application table name.

methods.name: retrieveDatatable
methods.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a specific datatable after validating read permissions.

methods.name: queryDataTable
methods.description: Executes a simple query on a datatable filtering by a specified column and value, returning JSON results.

methods.name: queryDataTableAdvanced
methods.description: Performs an advanced, paginated, and sorted query on a datatable based on complex filter criteria.

methods.name: buildDataQueryEmbedded
methods.description: Builds SQL query parts for embedded data retrieval based on filters and result columns, validating permissions.

methods.name: retrieveDataTableGenericResultSet
methods.description: Retrieves a generic result set for a data table, validating scope and permissions.

methods.name: countDatatableEntries
methods.description: Counts the number of entries in a specified datatable for a given application record.

methods.name: getDataTableName
methods.description: Extracts the datatable name from a URL string.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Extracts the table name from a URL string.
